## Overview

Add support for Domyn Edge (`DomynEdgeForCausalLM`), a ~4B dense decoder released by Domyn: [`domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base`](https://huggingface.co/domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base) and [`domyn/Domyn-Edge-SFT`](https://huggingface.co/domyn/Domyn-Edge-SFT).

## Changes

- New architecture `DomynEdgeForCausalLM` with interleaved RoPE/NoPE attention layers, per-layer sliding windows (1024 tokens or full attention), QK-norm, pre/post sandwich RMSNorms (as in Gemma2), and tied embeddings.
- Outputs match the HF reference implementation, including beyond the 1024-token sliding window.
- GSM8K accuracy matches the scores published on the model cards (Base 71.8 vs 71.6; SFT 91.2 vs 94.6) using the provided script in the vLLM codebase.

## Validation

**Tests** (1x A100 64GB, CUDA 13.0, torch 2.14.0, Python 3.12.11, pytest 9.1.0):

```bash
$ pytest tests/models/test_registry.py -v -k DomynEdge
tests/models/test_registry.py::test_registry_imports[DomynEdgeForCausalLM] PASSED
1 passed, 422 deselected, 2 warnings in 3.36s

$ pytest tests/models/test_initialization.py -v -k DomynEdge
tests/models/test_initialization.py::test_can_initialize_large_subset[DomynEdgeForCausalLM] PASSED
1 passed, 406 deselected, 3 warnings in 16.19s

$ pytest tests/models/language/generation/test_common.py -v -k Domyn-Edge-Base
tests/models/language/generation/test_common.py::test_models[True-False-5-32-domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base] PASSED
tests/models/language/generation/test_common.py::test_models[False-False-5-32-domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base] PASSED
2 passed, 40 deselected, 7 warnings in 151.93s (0:02:31)
```

`pre-commit` passes on all changed files.

**GSM8K** (`tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py`, 1319 questions, 5-shot):

| Model | Endpoint | Sampling | Max tokens | vLLM | Model card |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Domyn-Edge-Base | `/v1/completions` | greedy | 256 | **71.8** | 71.6 |
| Domyn-Edge-SFT | `/v1/chat/completions`, thinking on | model defaults (T=1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20) | 8192 | **91.2** | 94.6 |

```bash
# Base
vllm serve domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096
python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py

# SFT
vllm serve domyn/Domyn-Edge-SFT --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 16384 --reasoning-parser qwen3
python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --use-chat-completions --max-tokens 8192 --request-timeout-seconds 7200
```

The SFT run samples with the model's `generation_config.json` defaults, so a few points of variance against the model card are expected (invalid-response rate 1.0%).

Dump of the logs of the runs:

- `domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base`
```json

  "invalid_rate": 0.002274450341167551,
  "latency": 48.89986854791641,
  "questions_per_second": 26.973487642559352,
  "total_output_tokens": 157962,
  "tokens_per_second": 3230.3154321409856,
  "num_questions": 1319,
  "num_shots": 5,
  "max_tokens": 256,

      "Question",
      "Assistant:",
      "<|separator|>"
    ],
    "reasoning_effort": null,
    "chat_template_kwargs": null
  }
}
```

- `domyn/Domyn-Edge-SFT`

```json
{
  "accuracy": 0.9120545868081881,
  "invalid_rate": 0.0,
  "latency": 752.0309927035123,
  "questions_per_second": 1.7539170762873264,
  "total_output_tokens": 1877157,
  "tokens_per_second": 2496.1165406916516,
  "num_questions": 1319,
  "num_shots": 5,
  "max_tokens": 8192,
  "timestamp": 1792764428.8579721,
  "request_params": {
    "endpoint": "chat",
    "model": null,
    "temperature": null,

    "top_k": null,
    "seed": 42,
    "stop": null,
    "reasoning_effort": null,
    "chat_template_kwargs": null
  }
}
```

## Details

Architecture highlights:

- **Interleaved RoPE / NoPE layers** (`position_layers`): NoPE layers skip the rotary embedding.
- **Per-layer sliding windows** (`window_sizes`): RoPE layers use a 1024-token window, NoPE layers use full attention.
- **Per-layer head sizes** (`head_sizes`).
- **QK-norm**, with a weightless RMSNorm on Q and a learned RMSNorm on K.
- **Gemma2-style sandwich norms**: pre- and post-norms around both attention and MLP.

The decoder stack reuses `Qwen2Model` and `Qwen2MLP`.

The test registry entry uses `trust_remote_code=True` because the HF reference implementation is shipped as remote code in the model repo.

`Domyn-Edge-SFT` is registered as an `extras` entry.

No other open PR requests for Domyn Edge have been found.

🚀

Hi @DarkLight1337, I am Alberto Veneri, a member of the technical staff @ [Domyn](https://www.domyn.com) and first-time contributor here. We just started to release the checkpoints of Domyn Edge on HF, see [our latest blogpost](https://www.domyn.com/blog/domyn-edge-compact-model-open), and we would like to integrate the support for our new model on vLLM.
Could you add the verified label so the pre-commit can run on the vLLM CI? I’ve run pre-commit locally and everything seems to be ok.
Thank you!

Thanks for the suggestion. We tried `--model-impl transformers` with the current checkpoint (`vllm serve domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base --trust-remote-code --model-impl transformers`). It fails at model init with:
```bash
ValueError: Layer 0 does not dispatch through the Transformers attention interface and vLLM has no other way to handle it.
```
The remote modeling code calls `torch.nn.attention.varlen.varlen_attn` directly, with its own padding and KV-cache handling, instead of going through `ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS`. Supporting the Transformers backend would mean rewriting the HF attention to use the attention interface, and check the compatibility of the per-layer sliding windows (currently a custom window_sizes list).
Should we investigate further how to make our HF modeling code work with vLLM’s Transformers backend, given our architecture?
I think we could merge this PR first and investigate how to support it using Transformers backend later. cc @hmellor
Meanwhile please try to get HF modelling to work ASAP, because this model might get deprecated in the future if it doesn't keep getting enough downloads.
Per layer sliding window has been supported in both Transformers and the Transformers backend for a very long time

> Meanwhile please try to get HF modelling to work ASAP, because this model might get deprecated in the future if it doesn't keep getting enough downloads.

Yes, thank you for heads up on the deprecation policy, we are already working on a new HF modeling.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
Thanks, overall LGTM, just one comment
Is the config needed? We could automatically load configs from HF Hub via `--trust-remote-code`

Thank you for the quick feedback. We discussed this internally and it is ok to load the configs directly from HF Hub via `--trust-remote-code`. We would like to avoid to use the flag `--trust-remote-code` but we are going to work on the `transformers` side. I am going now to delete the configs related file and re-run the tests.

Hi @DarkLight1337, we updated the modeling on all our hf checkpoints to use `per_layer_config` and solved a  compatibility issue by using `--trust-remote-code` in vLLM with our previous HF modeling. https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62544/commits/4f80ea4da0777e1cb4b5c2383ed6104820ca8298 removed the vLLM config and update the executor to use `per_layer_config`.
I re-ran all the tests and updated the PR description when needed.
Btw, have you tried using Transformers backend to run this model? If it works just as well, this PR might not even be needed 😅

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Domyn
+
+# Adapted from https://huggingface.co/domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base
+"""Inference-only DomynEdge model compatible with HuggingFace weights."""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.compilation.decorators import support_torch_compile
+from vllm.config import CacheConfig, VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed import get_pp_group, get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import Attention
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import QKVParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import ParallelLMHead
+from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import AttentionType
+
+from .qwen2 import Qwen2MLP, Qwen2Model
+from .utils import AutoWeightsLoader, PPMissingLayer, extract_layer_index, maybe_prefix
+
+
+class DomynEdgeAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        num_heads: int,
+        num_kv_heads: int,
+        rope_parameters: dict,
+        head_dim: int,
+        max_position: int = 4096 * 32,
+        rms_norm_eps: float = 1e-06,
+        qkv_bias: bool = False,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        window_size: int = 0,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.total_num_heads = num_heads
+        assert self.total_num_heads % tp_size == 0
+        self.num_heads = self.total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.total_num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, self.total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = head_dim
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5
+
+        if self.total_num_kv_heads >= tp_size:
+            # Number of KV heads is greater than TP size, so we partition
+            # the KV heads across multiple tensor parallel GPUs.
+            assert self.total_num_kv_heads % tp_size == 0
+        else:
+            # Number of KV heads is less than TP size, so we replicate
+            # the KV heads across multiple tensor parallel GPUs.
+            assert tp_size % self.total_num_kv_heads == 0
+
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            self.hidden_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.total_num_heads,
+            self.total_num_kv_heads,
+            bias=qkv_bias,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            self.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+
+        self.rotary_emb = (
+            get_rope(
+                self.head_dim,
+                max_position=max_position,
+                rope_parameters=rope_parameters,
+                dtype=torch.float,
+            )
+            if rope_parameters is not None
+            else None
+        )
+
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.scaling,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+            attn_type=AttentionType.DECODER,
+            # HF window (w, 0) attends to w+1 keys; vLLM's window counts all keys.
+            per_layer_sliding_window=window_size + 1 if window_size > 0 else None,
+        )
+        self.q_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=rms_norm_eps, has_weight=False)
+        self.k_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=rms_norm_eps)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        q_by_head = q.view(*q.shape[:-1], q.shape[-1] // self.head_dim, self.head_dim)
+        q_by_head = self.q_norm(q_by_head)
+        q = q_by_head.view(q.shape)
+        k_by_head = k.view(*k.shape[:-1], k.shape[-1] // self.head_dim, self.head_dim)
+        k_by_head = self.k_norm(k_by_head)
+        k = k_by_head.view(k.shape)
+        if self.rotary_emb is not None:
+            q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q.float(), k.float())
+            q = q.type_as(hidden_states)
+            k = k.type_as(hidden_states)
+        attn_output = self.attn(q, k, v)
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(attn_output)
+        return output
+
+
+class DomynEdgeDecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        position_type = config.position_layers[layer_idx]
+
+        match position_type:
+            case "rope":
+                rope_parameters = config.rope_parameters
+            case "nope":
+                rope_parameters = None
+            case _:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Unsupported position encoding type for layer "
+                    f"{layer_idx}: {position_type}"
+                )
+
+        self.attention = DomynEdgeAttention(
+            hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+            num_heads=config.num_attention_heads,
+            max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+            num_kv_heads=config.num_key_value_heads,
+            rms_norm_eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            qkv_bias=False,
+            head_dim=config.per_layer_config[layer_idx].head_dim,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            rope_parameters=rope_parameters,
+            window_size=config.window_sizes[layer_idx][0],
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attention",
+        )
+        self.feedforward = Qwen2MLP(
+            hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=config.intermediate_size,
+            hidden_act=config.hidden_act,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.feedforward",
+        )
+        self.pre_attention_norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.post_attention_norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.pre_feedforward_norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.post_feedforward_norm = RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if residual is None:
+            residual = hidden_states
+            hidden_states = self.pre_attention_norm(hidden_states)
+        else:
+            hidden_states, residual = self.pre_attention_norm(hidden_states, residual)
+        hidden_states = self.post_attention_norm(
+            self.attention(
+                positions=positions,
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+            )
+        )
+
+        hidden_states, residual = self.pre_feedforward_norm(hidden_states, residual)
+        hidden_states = self.post_feedforward_norm(self.feedforward(hidden_states))
+        return hidden_states, residual
+
+
+@support_torch_compile(
+    dynamic_arg_dims={
+        "input_ids": 0,
+        "positions": -1,
+        "intermediate_tensors": 0,
+        "inputs_embeds": 0,
+    }
+)
+class DomynEdgeModel(Qwen2Model):
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        super().__init__(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            prefix=prefix,
+            decoder_layer_type=DomynEdgeDecoderLayer,
+        )
+
+
+class DomynEdgeForCausalLM(nn.Module):
+    packed_modules_mapping = {
+        "qkv_proj": [
+            "q_proj",
+            "k_proj",
+            "v_proj",
+        ],
+        "gate_up_proj": [
+            "gate_proj",
+            "up_proj",
+        ],
+    }
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+
+        self.config = config
+
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        self.quant_config = quant_config
+        self.model = DomynEdgeModel(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model")
+        )
+
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            if config.tie_word_embeddings:
+                self.lm_head = self.model.embed_tokens
+            else:
+                self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+                    config.vocab_size,
+                    config.hidden_size,
+                    quant_config=quant_config,
+                    prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+                )
+        else:
+            self.lm_head = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config.vocab_size)
+
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = (
+            self.model.make_empty_intermediate_tensors
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | IntermediateTensors:
+        return self.model(input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, inputs_embeds)
+
+    def compute_logits(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.logits_processor(self.lm_head, hidden_states)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        return loader.load_weights(weights)

Hi @DarkLight1337, I am Alberto Veneri, a member of the technical staff @ [Domyn](https://www.domyn.com) and first-time contributor here. We just started to release the checkpoints of Domyn Edge on HF, see [our latest blogpost](https://www.domyn.com/blog/domyn-edge-compact-model-open), and we would like to integrate the support for our new model on vLLM.
Could you add the verified label so the pre-commit can run on the vLLM CI? I’ve run pre-commit locally and everything seems to be ok.
Thank you!

Thanks for the suggestion. We tried `--model-impl transformers` with the current checkpoint (`vllm serve domyn/Domyn-Edge-Base --trust-remote-code --model-impl transformers`). It fails at model init with:
```bash
ValueError: Layer 0 does not dispatch through the Transformers attention interface and vLLM has no other way to handle it.
```
The remote modeling code calls `torch.nn.attention.varlen.varlen_attn` directly, with its own padding and KV-cache handling, instead of going through `ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS`. Supporting the Transformers backend would mean rewriting the HF attention to use the attention interface, and check the compatibility of the per-layer sliding windows (currently a custom window_sizes list).
Should we investigate further how to make our HF modeling code work with vLLM’s Transformers backend, given our architecture?
I think we could merge this PR first and investigate how to support it using Transformers backend later. cc @hmellor
Meanwhile please try to get HF modelling to work ASAP, because this model might get deprecated in the future if it doesn't keep getting enough downloads.
Per layer sliding window has been supported in both Transformers and the Transformers backend for a very long time

> Meanwhile please try to get HF modelling to work ASAP, because this model might get deprecated in the future if it doesn't keep getting enough downloads.

Yes, thank you for heads up on the deprecation policy, we are already working on a new HF modeling.
